favourite.heading: Why NC State can pull away
bullets: NC State is the better football team by 7.4 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+7.4 pts).
Playing at NC State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 3.5 points to NC State (+3.5 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours NC State by 1.2 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.2 pts).

underdog.heading: Why App State can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -6.8 to p90 +37.2 for NC State, so a projection of +16.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
